verseText: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David...
meaning: God promised David his family would rule over God's people forever. God kept that promise by sending Jesus to be born into David's family.

meaning.question: What promise did God keep through Jesus?
choices: David's family would have a forever King

application.prompt: Thank God that He keeps His promises, even when they take a long time to be fulfilled.
